sourceNotes: Verification date means official online descriptions inspected on 2026-10-25, not provider contacted or quality certified. No testimonials or commercial rankings were used.
CH denotes a nationwide route/directory, not a promise of offices, language service or eligibility in every canton. Regional limits are stated in access notes.
Inclusion Handicap page lists German and French services; Ticino is excluded from canton list rather than inventing Italian service.
Procap cost source is its official Beistandschaft flyer; additional regional official rules differ (Procap Jura two years membership; NW entry fees). Do not flatten to a universal free service.
Pro Infirmis nationwide scope and free consultation verified at https://www.proinfirmis.ch/; detailed social insurance eligibility at its Zurich advice page.

Patients federation directory checked; prices cross-checked at https://basel.patientenstelle.ch/offer/ and https://zh.patientenstelle.ch/angebote-und-leistungen/ and https://www.patientenstelle-aargau-solothurn.ch/beratung. They differ materially.
Ombudsstelle Krankenversicherung service/cost verified from federal BFK directory; provider site could not be fetched by web tool. Keep sourceUrl on BFK and manually recheck provider availability.

TGNS has free trans-specific legal advice but no litigation mandates. Pink Cross has free member first advice and expressly excludes asylum advice. These are not interchangeable general LGBTQ advice routes.
SPO was excluded as legal advice: current official membership FAQ https://www.spo.ch/aktiv-werden/mitglied-werden explicitly says it generally does not offer legal advice.

142 is current national victim-aid contact, confirmed at https://sodk.ch/de/themen/opferhilfe/zentrale-opferhilfe-telefonnummer/ and official victim-aid directory. Avoid old assumptions that only local victim-aid numbers exist.
Copy translations cover de/fr/it/rm/en and describe services only, not consultation languages. Romansh copy is an editorial draft and has not been independently proofread by a Romansh speaker.
gaps: No claim of exhaustive inventory. Include these national specialist routes alongside canton-specific legal clinics, bar associations, tenancy, migration and family advice researched by other agents.
FRC covers Romandie; ACSI official current service page could not be verified confidently, so not included from old 2019/2020 PDFs.
General equality directory is a routing resource, not evidence that all listed bodies provide individual legal advice.
Romansch advice availability not confirmed for these services. Website translation must not be treated as consultation-language evidence.
Syna national site not reliably retrieved, so Unia included with member restrictions rather than unverified alternative union fee claims.
Add a public corrections route and periodic revalidation of destination links, costs, access restrictions and directory contacts.
